Frequently asked questions

Do I have to be a Christian to volunteer?

No. We are a Christian charity and we pray together, but every kind-hearted person is welcome.

How old do I need to be?

16 for food drives, with an adult; 18 for street outreach [to confirm].

Is a background check required?

For activities with children, yes. We will walk you through it [to confirm].

What if I need to cancel?

Write to us as soon as you can to free the spot: someone else may be waiting for it.

La Paix du Cœur Kimia Na Motema

A Christian charity in Montréal since 2014: street outreach, food drives and mutual aid for orphans, widows, people in need and the homeless.
